purpose: Stage-1 informational paired baseline: LCI semantic-navigation arm vs lexical grep/glob/read arm over the full committed exploration task bank. Observations only; not a merge gate.

scorer.judge: none (no LLM judge; no repo-QA regex fact score)

task_bank.task_digest_recipe: task_digest.task_digest(canonical sort_keys JSON of full task)

subject_binary.name: lci
subject_binary.invocation: lci mcp (stdio), registered as server 'lci' via --mcp-config

treatment.description: LCI MCP semantic exploration tools + Read

baseline.description: Lexical Grep + Glob + Read only; no LCI server attached

model.note: Harness default (exploration_runner.DEFAULT_MODEL). This is the arm-shared model for BOTH arms; the only variable across arms is the tool surface.

repetitions.note: Stage-1 pins reps=1. Variance-powered replication (>=3 reps, spread, minimum-successes gate) is explicitly deferred to a later task and is out of scope here.

budget.note: A spending cap was never set because no paid run was authorized (see approval).

approval.reason: This stage-1 configuration was pinned by an unattended implementer session. A paid Claude CLI grid requires an explicit user-approved model and spending/time budget recorded before launch; no approver was present and no provider credentials are configured on this host (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN unset). Per design-unbiased-benchmarks stop conditions, an unapproved/uncapable paid grid must not be launched or its failures scored as answers.

execution.reason: paid_run_approval_not_granted; provider credentials not configured on this host
execution.omission_policy: Every planned (task, arm, rep) cell is present in run-records.jsonl with a machine-readable status; none were silently dropped.
